This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and baked data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**Answer.**
801 Father Capodanno Boulevard, Staten Island, was recorded within the empirical 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint [sandy_inundation]. The address is mapped within FEMA flood zone AE, indicating it is a Special Flood Hazard Area as of 2007 [fema_nfhl]. The address is outside the modeled flooding for the NYC DEP stormwater scenario in 2050 with a 2.13 in/hr rainfall and sea-level rise [dep_moderate_2050].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
